faqs.question: Which questions should a Vice President of Sales resolve before a target discussion in Technology, Media and Telecom?

faqs.answer: Describe an instance where the candidate could lead a sales organization and connect market priorities with execution; connect its decisions and learning to digital products, platforms, content, communications, or technology-enabled services. faqs.question: How should a Vice President of Sales compare title and remit in Technology, Media and Telecom?
